data.rationale: The proposal captures the same Kayak hotel-search procedure (open hotels search, type destination and pick a suggestion, pick dates, search, set rooms and guests with Increment then Update, sort by Price low to high) with the right parameters, but it hard-codes the price sort and splits the filters into vague optional ones. It also lists rooms and guests as separate counts and is slightly unclear about the order after Search, which still leaves it buildable.
